reviews.title: Great stealth, stagehand library is nice
reviews.pros: Browserbase's stealth / captcha solving seems to be the best out of the modern AI-centric browser hosts. I like the stagehand library too.
reviews.cons: Support for SMS 2FA codes requires some manual setup to connect an MCP server to their agent.
reviews.overall: The suite is nice, I like how Director.ai stacks on top of Stagehand which stacks on top of the browser. Browser platform is solid, being able to get all session recordings as mp4s / embed live sessions as iframes in your apps is great.

reviews.title: STRONGLY AVOID - really unreliable and will cancel without warning and core features dont work
reviews.pros:
Makes it easy to stream a browser. in theory the proxy stuff would be good but didn't work very well.
